items.name: Comedian Tara Cannistraci Headlines The Riot Houston
items.caption:
The comic behind the debut special I'm Just a Girl has family chaos in her sights.
Tara Cannistraci performs at The Riot Comedy Club on November 8, 2026. Her debut special, I'm Just a Girl, is available online. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
